svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut two 642 mm lengths of 30 x 6 mm aluminium flat bar.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Holes 6.5 mm on the centre line, 11, 331 and 631 mm from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bottom: these bolt through the three upper cross bars.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark the cross bars through the uprights and drill them 6.5 mm,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: front to back. M6 x 70 bolts, nyloc nuts on the load side.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The uprights stand 120 mm either side of the centre line on the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: back of the cross bars, bottom 11 mm below the lower bar.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill for the parts they carry, from the bottom of the upright:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: electronics box 126 to 236 mm; fuse box 271 to 311 mm;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: pack cradle 336 to 526 mm. Use each part's own mounting holes.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Deburr all holes. Do not weld aluminium to the steel frame.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: both uprights sit flat on all three bars.
